strategyVersion.description: Strategy version identifier to use for this simulation

startDate.description: Simulation start timestamp in ISO-8601 format (use startTime as alternative)

endDate.description: Simulation end timestamp in ISO-8601 format (use endTime as alternative)

startTime.description: Alternative to startDate for frontend compatibility

endTime.description: Alternative to endDate for frontend compatibility

initialCapital.description: Simplified initial capital (alternative to initialPortfolio). Will be converted to portfolio with only cash.

notes.description: Optional user notes about the simulation

initialPortfolio.description: Initial portfolio state (cash and positions). Optional if initialCapital is provided.

version.description: Version identifier following semantic versioning (e.g., v1.0, v2.0-alpha)

markdownContent.description: Markdown content describing the trading strategy
examples: # My Trading Strategy\n\nThis strategy uses momentum indicators...

notes.description: Optional notes about this strategy version
examples: Initial version with basic momentum rules

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 7807 Problem Details for HTTP APIs - standardized error response

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence

instance.description: URI reference identifying the specific occurrence

errors.description: List of validation errors (present for 400 Bad Request responses)

get.description: Retrieves consensus decisions (aggregated from LLM agents) for a simulation, optionally filtered by time range and execution status

parameters.description: Filter by execution status (true = executed, false = not executed)
parameters.name: executed

parameters.description: Maximum number of decisions to return (1-1000)
parameters.name: limit

400.description: Bad request - missing required parameters or invalid format

get.description: Retrieves individual LLM agent decisions for a simulation, optionally filtered by time range and agent ID

parameters.description: Maximum number of decisions to return (1-1000)
parameters.name: limit

400.description: Bad request - missing required parameters or invalid format

post.description: Manually triggers data collection from all enabled market data providers. Useful for testing and on-demand data ingestion.

get.description: Retrieves historical market events (price updates, news, Reddit posts) within a specified time range with optional filters

parameters.description: Filter by event type (PRICE_UPDATE, NEWS, REDDIT_POST)
parameters.name: eventType

parameters.description: Maximum number of events to return (1-1000)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Filter by trading symbol (e.g., BTC, ETH)
parameters.name: symbol

400.description: Bad request - missing required parameters or invalid format

422.description: Unprocessable entity - time range exceeds 365 days or 'from' is after 'to'

get.description: Retrieves historical portfolio snapshots for a simulation, showing portfolio state over time

parameters.description: Maximum number of snapshots to return (1-1000)
parameters.name: limit

400.description: Bad request - missing required parameters or invalid format

get.description: Retrieves all simulations, optionally filtered by status

parameters.description: Filter by simulation status (PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED)
parameters.name: status

post.description: Creates a new backtesting simulation with specified strategy, time range, and initial portfolio

201.description: Simulation created successfully with Location header pointing to the new resource

get.description: Retrieves a specific simulation by its unique identifier

delete.description: Deletes a simulation. Cannot delete a simulation that is currently running.

204.description: Simulation deleted successfully - no content returned

409.description: Conflict - cannot delete a running simulation

post.description: Starts the execution of a pending simulation. The simulation will run through the configured time range and evaluate trading decisions at the specified intervals.

200.description: Simulation started successfully and execution completed

409.description: Conflict - simulation is not in PENDING status

500.description: Internal server error or simulation execution failed

patch.description: Updates the status of a simulation (e.g., to stop a running simulation)

get.description: Retrieves all trading strategy versions available in the system

post.description: Creates a new trading strategy version with markdown content

value.markdownContent:
# My Trading Strategy

This strategy focuses on momentum trading...

201.description: Strategy created successfully with Location header pointing to the new resource

put.description: Updates an existing trading strategy's content and notes. Version in request body must match the path parameter.

400.description: Bad request - validation failed or version mismatch

get.description: Retrieves a specific trading strategy by its version identifier

delete.description: Deletes a trading strategy version. Note: Currently does not check for simulation references.

204.description: Strategy deleted successfully - no content returned

info.title: QuorumTrading API
info.description: REST API and WebSocket streaming for QuorumTrading algorithmic trading platform. Provides endpoints for strategy management, backtesting simulations, market data queries, agent decision tracking, and portfolio monitoring. Real-time updates available via WebSocket subscriptions.
